verdict.rationale: Kick documents native AR in its Plus plan and lets users view synced invoices from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL and create and send invoices, so basic receivables tracking is the product's own capability. However, the aging and vendor-balance views it documents are for AP, not AR, and that evidence does not transfer to this story. Missing for 10: a documented AR aging report, per-customer balance views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances

citations.quote: Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
